translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

book.name: 1 CORINTIOS
book.title: Corintosha keranguemulachi Pablo' pilla kiika main

content: Iya tyee kes jintsuñu bain inaa keetadi' tsanguidei, i bain naajuwa Cristo tyee kemuñuba yanaa keetadi' tsanguemuyu.
Diosnu balenguunu dewa'diñu, supulaya naakenu juñu bain
Ñulla' mitya sundee tinu tenve, matyu naa-uwanuba inu tengaya deju', ñullanu naake mijakaañuba tsangues jindetsuñu' mitya.
Tsaaren aseeta dejusa tenve naaju rukulachi bain Cristo ya' mishu juuñuunmala, supuchi bain unbee rukaa ya' mishu juuñuuve, matyu naajuinga Cristochi bain Diosyaa ya' mishu juuñuushu juntsaatu.
Tsaaren dewa'na' ma ruku Diosba kuinda kendu, ne Diosa' mitya patindu bain ya' mishusha jali viyake'banguishu juntsaa, ya' mishu juuñuunu balengurendyuve.

Tsenmala dewa'na' ma supu shinbu bain Diosba kuinda kikendu ne Diosa' mitya patindu, ya' mishusha jali viyajtushu juntsaa, ya' mishu juuñuunu firu' kentsurentsuve, ura pañuya, ya' mishu chapajkukungue dalaañuu juuve.

Matyu ma shinbu ya' mishusha jali vikityushu juntsaa, ya' mishunu achuwa chapajkukungue daakutiñuba ne uraave. Tsaaren supula ne achuwa juntsangue daakuti' chapajkuku keñu bain, ma yujpeyaave tyanu deeshu juntsaa, ya' mishusha jali viya kisa.

Unbee rukuya mishusha jali viyanu jutyuve, matyu yaa Dios naajuñuba tsaa keewaramin, naa Dios tsamantsaa juñu bain keewaramin ju' mitya. Tsaanuren supuya unbee ruku' mityaren juntsaa uukeraa faawara keewarave,
matyu unbee rukuya supunu kalare' kiñu jutyuve; supu shinbaa unbee rukunu kalare' kiñu juve.
Unbee rukuya supunu ura' ikaanu indyuve, supaa unbee rukunu ura' ikaanu ive.
Entsaañu' mitya, tsenmin anjeelanu bain balengure' keewaatu, supu shinbuya ya' mishusha jali vikitaa ya bain Diosnu balengurenuu juve ti' keewara juve.
Naa tsaañu bain, Bale Rukunu keenguemu chachillachiya unbee ruku supu jutyuya tiba jutyuve, supu bain unbee ruku jutyuya tiba jutyuve.

Uwain ajke' tinbunu Dios supu shinbu ketu ajke' jumu unbee rukunaa kalare' ke' kujteve; naa tsaañu bain, challaya naaju unbee rukulaba supu shinbunu tene fale' jamu deeve. Tsaaren naa unbee ruku bain, naa supu shinbu bain, naa tiba jumula bain Dioschi imu tene judeeve.
Ñui teneren pensangue' keedei, matyu supula mishusha tiba viyajtu Diosba kuinda keñu urañu bain.
Ne keranchin mikeeve naa unbee rukulaya achuwa aabarewaañu mayujpeyaa juñu bain.
Tsejturen supulachiya yuj uukera juve achuwa aabarewaañu, matyu supulanuya yala' mishu dishkaanaa tsaa achuwa aabare tirañu' mitya.

Naa tsaañu bain, mun entsa detiñu meenguindyai'tu vej vej patinuu ju' bain mijanu dejuve naa laa bain, naa kerangue' vee vee mujtu waku wakudimula bain Diosnu balenguunu wa'di' tsa tsanguemu deeve ti', supula mishusha jali viya viyakenu dejutyuve ti' panu dejutyuñuba.
Bale Rukunu mandenga'panda finutala ura' kityu deeñu
Challa kayu piikikenu juuwashu juntsanu panmalaya ne ñulla' mitya sundenve tikeenu jutyuve, matyu ñulla waku wakudeditu kayu uraanuuba junuunuren, firu' tiyanchee ne defiru' tiyaindetsuñu' mitya.
Ajke' pamiya, ñullanu entsa detiñu meeja meejaive, ñulla Diosnu balenguunu wa'dimiya ñuitala ajaavi' vela vela deiñu kuinda meejave. Tsa detiñu uwain jayu tsa deeve tejave.
Uwain ñuitala naake'ba velainuuya dejuve, tsejtaa ñuitala naajulaa aawa tyamu deju'ba tsangue dekeewaanu.

Matyu entsai' develantsulaya ñulla Jesús' mitya ti' panda finu dewa'di' bain, main main titi finu taji' bain veelanu keenai'mujchi jeke fifidekiñuve. Tsenmalaa mantsalaya panda fajtuuba delaranmala, yumaa mantsalaya deviñaaba juju deeñuve. ¡Juntsa de' mityaa Jesús' mitya ti' wa'di' panda fiñunguityu juju deeve!

¿Tsejtu ñulla naa panda fikenu bain, naa kujchikenu bain ñulla' ya tajdetuu? ¿Nenñaa Diosnu keranguemu chachillanaa balejtu kurendu dekiyu, tsangue' naa tiba tajtu chachillanu bain yujpewarendu? ¿Challa ñullanu tyeendinu juwa? ¿Yuj ura' dekive tinu juwa? Entsa' mityaya yuj ura' dekive tinu jutyuyu.
Jesús' mitya ti' panda fitunaakenuu juñu bain

Matyu entsa iya ñullanu mijakaakentsaashu juntsa Bale Rukuren inu tsanguenu mijakaañu, i bain ñullanu tsaa mamijakaayu: matyu Bale Ruku Jesús, wandya' peesu kakaranu juñu keperen panda finundiyandu pan ka',
Diosnu yuj urave ti', pan dyaityuitu entsandimuwaave: Entsa pan in buluve, ñulla' mitya kuwainuushu juntsa. Naa-uwanuba entsanguiikidei inu mandenganu, tive.

Tsenmin bene panda fi' dyatu binu pumu basu bain ka' entsandimuwaave: Entsa binu basuya in asave, kasa bijee ñuiba veta' veta' tsanguedaa tiñu keewara jumu. Naa-uwanu in mitya ti' kujchike' bain inu mandenga' tsa tsanguidei, timuwaave.
Tsa' mitya naa-uwanu tsangue' entsa pan fike' bain, naa entsa binu kujchike' bain, Bale Ruku peyamuwaave ti' mijakaandetsuve ya' maangama.

Tsa' mitya mun Bale Ruku' mitya ti' pan fike' bain, naa binu kujchike' bain, naa junuu juñuba tsa jutyuren tsanguishu juntsaa, Bale Ruku' bulunu bain, naa ya' asanu bain juntsangue' balengure' keewaatyu ju' ujcha lantsuve.
Tsa' mitya main main Jesús' mitya ti' naa pan juuñu bain fityumujchin, naa binu juu bain kayu kujchityumujchin, naa naaken chu'ba keenu dejuve,
matyu naa pan fike' bain, naa binu kujchike' bain, Jesús' bulunaa tsanguendu bain tiba jutyuuñungue kurendetsushu juntsaa, maaliren kuipa vi' taaju-i' puinuuya kendetsuve.
Matyu tsanguemu de' mityaa, pure' chachilla ñuitala diluu derajtu dejuve, tsai' mantsalaa yumaa depeyave.
Tsaaren naa mu bain main main lala' pensasha kere' ura' kemu deetuya, Bale Rukuchi lala taaju ityuchu deeyu,
tsejturen naamika Bale Ruku lalanu tsangue' taaju iware' bain, ura' demandisa tyataa tsanguive, tsejtaa ujcha lan chumu chachillaba bene bulu taaju iwaren jutyu.
Tsa' mitya keranguemu naatalala, naa-uwanu Jesús' mitya ti' panda finu wa'di'ba, veta' veta' keenanuu dejuve kayu wa'dindetyuya.

Mun tsandenna panda iintsushu juntsaa ñulla' yasha fidei, tsanguishu juntsaa, panda finu dewa'di' ura' ki'tu Dioschi taaju iwaran dejutyu. Kayu vera tyee kenuu juñuba ñulla' junga maataa mijanu tsuyu.
